Name: Moolah Money Mod
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod allows the game to store money beyond the vanilla limit of two billion (Int32.MaxValue).

[s]The new limit is 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 (Int64.MaxValue)

[/s]With this mod there is basically* no limit to how much money you can own.

It also lets you display a separator (default [b]comma[/b]) every set number of digits (default [b]3[/b]).

[size=2]* The amount is stored in a string, which can hold just over two-billion digits, so that's the technical upper limit. A googol has 101 digits. Your computer will run out of memory and / or you will be dead by the time this limit is reached.
[/size]

[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

This mod doesn't fix the fact that things like prices still use Int32 and have a maximum of ~2.1 billion. If for some reason you want to add or subtract more than this in one go, you can use the SMAPI API.
[size=2]

[size=5][b]SMAPI API[/b][/size]
[/size]
There are two methods in the API:

[b]AddMoolah(Farmer f, BigInteger add);[/b]

and

[b]GetTotalMoolah(Farmer f);[/b]

You don't need to pass a [b]BigInteger[/b] to [b]AddMoolah[/b]; any integer-type number will work, as long as it has less than ~2.1 billion digits.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
